My experience with Rentmatcha was very disappointing earlier from whom I coordinate at starting was a very cooperating person then my another executive took over my handle his name is something. First, they did not even remember the correct deposit amount. I had paid ₹2500, but they kept insisting it was only ₹1600, leading to repeated arguments.

When my rental tenure was ending, I informed them in advance that I was vacating the flat and they should collect their furniture. However, their approach was extremely unprofessional. They suddenly called me one evening saying they would come the next day after evening. I agreed, but then the next day they called at 2 PM saying they would arrive within an hour. At that time, I was at my office and explained that such last-minute changes made it impossible for me to hand over the furniture properly.

Instead of cooperating, they argued rudely, denied their own previous calls, and even lied about what they had said earlier. Their behavior over calls and messages was unprofessional, disrespectful, and full of unnecessary arguments.

Overall, Rentmatcha showed poor communication, lack of accountability, and very unprofessional conduct. I would not recommend them to anyone looking for a smooth rental experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sanchari Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst service! I have cancelled my subscription for a dining table and 4 chairs. The first pickup date was scheduled on 12th April. The driver didn’t turn up as he went on leave. No workaround provided. They scheduled the next pickup on 14th April, today. Driver calls up and says his vehicle is under fixing. No further information given. I called back the same number and he says he’s still delivering products to other customers and it will not be possible to pickup the stuffs. No options available to contact the customer service representative directly as they prefer to call back. I am a working woman. I can’t wait and stay back home everyday for them to come and pick up the goods. Simultaneously my purchased dining table has already arrived and there’s no space to walk in my living room. Most disgusting service staff. Think several times before you order anything from Furlenco!!!

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review after 2 weeks of total negligence from Furlenco. Please avoid renting from them at all costs. My experience has been a nightmare due to the following points:

• Safety Hazard: I rented a dining table 2 weeks ago. Two of the chairs delivered are damaged and have caused physical injury to my family.

• Ticket Manipulation: The only way to contact them is the app, but they keep cancelling/closing my service requests without any resolution. They simply cancel the ticket to avoid accountability.

• Lack of Access: There is absolutely no way to contact them easily. They have built a system specifically to hide from customers once they have collected the money.

• Unprofessional Staff: On the rare occasion I managed to connect with a representative, they were incredibly rude, arrogant, and dismissive of the fact that their product is causing harm. A Furlenco representative named Abrar finally came to inspect the product, but instead of fixing it, he damaged one of the chairs even further. He has become completely inaccessible and is ignoring all follow-ups.

Summary: Furlenco is happy to take your monthly rent but provides zero support when they deliver faulty, dangerous goods. I am now escalating this to the National Consumer Helpline.

featured_reviews.name: Agnibha Das
featured_reviews.review_text: Worse customer and delivery service. I was harassed by the customer service rep. I ordered 1 television which was not operational and there was no option on the app to return or file a complaint about product. Customer service is abysmal as it is not streamlined and takes a lot of time to connect with the representative. Moreover, while fighting with this issue I noticed that there was only 1 option to return the product which I proceeded with. Now they are saying that the product is returned and I will be able to avail its services in the following month after my payment is completed. I don’t know what to do as I have already paid for the product this month and haven’t been provided with a spare. The delivery does not provide the time they would be delivering the product. So they remain under assumption that we would be at home every time.

featured_reviews.name: Swapneel Malpekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Pathetic service and customer support. Delivered damaged product and no reply after raising complaint from last 4 days. Ruined our Ganapati festival experience for us.

Upon dialling the customer care number, you get to hear that the customer service executive will call within 30 minutes. It is sad to mention that this never happens. Despite waiting for 2-3 hours there is no call back.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Delivery was smooth and on time, and the installation was done neatly without any hassle. Everything was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as shown in the pictures. I also like the flexibility Furlenco offers with rental plans, which makes it a very convenient option without a heavy upfront cost.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable and practical study or work-from-home setup. 👍
